identities.name: Hantsy Bai
identities.bio: Hantsy Bai (@hantsy) is self-employed technology consultant focused on Java EE, Spring and Groovy. He lives in Guangzhou, China. Hantsy contributed many Simplified Chinese translations of the Arquillian guides, helping open the project to a whole new world of developers.
